digest.component_or_area: outbound field diff and codec layer (Cloud ADF + DC wiki)
propositions: Live Cloud and DC send paths must cut over to rich codecs (ADF and wiki) without emitting echo by comparing current state against last-synced baseline stored in binding_store

Lossy codec round-trips (decode∘encode ≠ identity) require two distinct compares: emit-compare uses inbound-decoded remote, baseline-compare normalizes local side through decode∘to_wire to match decoded baseline wire, keeping legacy un-normalized remote bodies upgrade exactly once then converge

DC WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound must be redefined as decode_inbound(to_wire(t)) to restore codec law; DC CREATE path at _map_local_to_dc_fields must render markdown before fit, mirroring send-path composition
Concurrent both-sides edits preserve rebar-local-wins and raise deduped outbound-field-conflict alert using existing conflict_sink mechanism without new LWW clock or three-way merge

Cutover ships flag-gated defaulting OFF and must tolerate no-extras install by lazy-importing marklas with ImportError fallback to plain-text ADF, degrading silently to today's behaviour rather than raising

Origin-gating via local≠baseline gate fires outbound only on rebar-originated change; inline 8-byte rich_sha change-gated hash stores baseline wire fingerprint (≤0.07 KB/version) instead of per-pass timestamp, and Jira-native constructs survive edit-free passes
